item.tib: 'chi kha bar do'i brda bstan gsal 'debs blo gros rgyal po
item.coloph: de ltar 'chi kha dus kyi bar do yi/ brda bstan gsal 'debs blo gros rgyal po 'di/ tshol ba'i blo ldan blon po su zhe na/ sa mtha'i mi chung dus mtha'i las goms pa/ skye 'chi'i sun pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan der/ rtsa ba'i mched grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen can/ mi rtag dran pa'i rin chen lhun grub kyis/ yang nas yang du bskul tshig 'di ltar sgron/ nam yang thams cad 'chi ba'i rang bzhin las/ 'o skol lta bu nam zhig dus babs tshe/ rang gi nyams su myong ba'i gsal 'debs shig med na gong ma'i bka' lung rgya che yang*/ rgyud thog khel ba dka' 'dug 'di 'dra zhig shin tu dgos so zer ba der brten nas/ snyan rgyud lhan skyes nye lam zab snying sogs/ dgongs don gtsor bton rang gi nyams myong gis/ go gsal phye nas tshigs su bcad pa 'dis/ skye 'gro tsam zhig rdzogs par ma nus kyang / go blo yod tsam thams cad grol bar 'gyur/ dge des yon tan nam mkha' sa gzhi ltar/ mtha' yas sems can ma lus khyab nas su/ kun tu bzang po'i ngang du sangs rgyas shog bkra shis so//
